A '''Human male''' with a mustache and goatee was an [[Imperial Knight]] in [[137 ABY]]. He was part of a large group of Knights that accompanied [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], serving as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] while Fel [[Mission to Agamar|conducted]] peace talks with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] on the planet's [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains. Everyone involved with the negotiations disguised themselves as [[Farm/Legends|farmers]]; the bearded [[Gender/Legends|male]] and several other Imperial Knights stood away and pretended to tend to a field close to the talks. However, he and everyone else cast off their disguises when a [[One Sith|Sith]] strike team [[Operation: Thunderstroke|attacked]]. The bearded male fought in the ensuing battle, and the Emperor, as well as most of the Imperial Knights and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], were able to evacuate the planet.

==Biography==
In [[137 ABY]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with a mustache and a goatee was a member of the [[Imperial Knight]]s,<ref name="Legacy 46" /> a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-using]] organization whose members dedicated themselves to preserving the [[Empire-in-exile]] and protecting its [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], [[Roan Fel]].<ref name="LECG">''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The bearded male was one of many Imperial Knights who accompanied Fel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]] in that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] while the Emperor secretly [[Mission to Agamar|met]] with members of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> On the planet's [[Grass/Legends|grassy]] plains, every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Imperial Knight donned a [[Farm/Legends|farmer]] disguise, and several Imperial Knight Masters stood with Fel as he and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] negotiated an alliance against the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Empire]]. The bearded male and several other Imperial Knights stood away from the talks, however, promoting their farmer deception by pretending to work on a field. Fel and K'Kruhk struck an agreement without incident, but the proceedings were interrupted soon after by [[Morrigan Corde|Nyna Calixte]]&mdash;the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence]] for Krayt's Empire&mdash;who was secretly an ally of Fel's.<ref name="Legacy 46" /><ref name="Legacy 45">[[Legacy (2006) 45|''Legacy'' (2006) 45]]</ref>

Calixte rode a [[Agamarian beast|local animal]] into the field where the bearded male stood and dismounted after two Imperial Knights fired [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] at her steed. She told the Jedi and Imperial Knights that Krayt's [[One Sith|Sith]] knew about the meeting, and that a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]&ndash;Imperial [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|task force]] was on its way to Agamar to capture or [[Death/Legends|kill]] the Emperor.<ref name="Legacy 45" /> When a Sith strike team rose from nearby swamps, a [[Operation: Thunderstroke|battle]] began. The bearded male shed his farmer robe and drew his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] when [[Antares Draco]],<ref name="Legacy 46" /> the leader of the Imperial Knights,<ref name="LECG" /> called on his Knights to defend the Emperor. The Jedi participated in the attempt to protect the Emperor, and at least ten Sith fell to the blades of their enemies, as well as to Calixte's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].<ref name="Legacy 46" /> Several Imperial Knights and Jedi died in the fray,<ref name="Legacy 48">[[Legacy (2006) 48|''Legacy'' (2006) 48]]</ref> but Fel and most of the survivors evacuated the battle on the escape [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Defender One]]''.<ref name="Legacy 46" />

==Powers and abilities==
As an Imperial Knight, the bearded male<ref name="Legacy 46" /> was part of an organization whose membership was limited to beings who could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Imperial Knights were said to be among the most talented and dangerous Force-users in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" />

==Equipment==
The bearded man wore [[Imperial Knight armor]] and used the order's [[Imperial Knight lightsaber|standard lightsaber]]. On Agamar, the Imperial Knight donned farmer's robes.<ref name="Legacy 46" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The black-haired Imperial Knight was created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'', and first appeared in its [[Legacy (2006) 45|forty-fifth issue]],<ref name="Legacy 45" /> which was released on [[February 24]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54417/star_wars_legacy_2006_45|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #45}}</ref>
